ensemble outlier detection method outperforms other outlier detection methods for multiclass problem.
the proposed SMOTE_VOTED ensemble method outperforms random forest, KNN, naive bayes, C4_5 and support vector machine methods.
the ensemble method outperforms the base classifier in terms of accuracy and precision and the performance of the ensemble method is better than that of the individual classifiers.

the development of ensemble methods for outlier detection for multichas problem in data mining.
the development of a novel outlier detection method for the multiclass problem in data mining using ensemble method.
the development of ensemble outlier detection methods for multiclass classification.

the proposed SMOTE_VOTED method is the most efficient outlier detection method for multi-class problem.
the proposed method outperforms the other methods in terms of accuracy, precision and f-measure and it is a better choice for the outlier detection for multilabel problem.
the proposed SMOTE_Vote ensemble method has the potential to improve performance of outlier detection methods in data mining.

we proposed a new ensemble outlier detection method that improves performance of random forest outlier detection method for a multiclass problem.
the proposed method is able to detect outliers and classify data instances with a very high accuracy.
the proposed SMOTE-Voted Outlier Ensemble method is a powerful and effective outlier detection technique for multiclass classification problems.

ensemble technique improves the performance of outlier detection in multiclass problem.
